body:
SQLB_PG_DSN and SQLB_MYSQL_DSN gate live suites. PostgreSQL array_sort, its descending form and array_reverse are exercised only at version 18 or newer; the old engine guide said 17. Extension tests can skip when the server lacks required extensions. Read verbose skips and state coverage limits, including the absence of a ClickHouse driver suite, before describing a green gate as multi-engine proof.

Evidence: ds:block?id=postgres-gate-ctc94x6a; ds:block?id=mysql-gate-xzbtwu8b; ds:block?id=postgres-arrays-5w7ytu86; ds:block?id=postgres-extensions-j5kc5mqu; ds:block?id=workspace-f7vpgvxp. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
title: Skipped server tests are not server proof
